title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
ac_text: A gift card code is 16 characters: letters A-Z and digits only.

title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
ac_text: The gift card pays as much of the order total as its balance allows; any remainder is paid by card.

title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
ac_text: A gift card with a zero balance shows "This gift card has no balance".

title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
ac_text: An unknown or badly formed code shows "Gift card code not recognised".

title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
ac_text: The gift card should be applied quickly.

title: Saved delivery addresses
ac_text: A shopper can save up to 5 delivery addresses.

title: Saved delivery addresses
ac_text: Guests can save a delivery address for their next visit.

title: Saved delivery addresses
ac_text: Only registered shoppers have an address book.

title: Saved delivery addresses
ac_text: The default address is pre-selected at checkout.

title: Show stock level on the product page
ac_text: When stock is 0, the product page shows "Out of stock" and the Add to cart button is disabled.

title: Show stock level on the product page
ac_text: When stock is 1 to 5, the product page shows "Only <n> left" where <n> is the stock number.

title: Show stock level on the product page
ac_text: When stock is 6 or more, no stock message is shown.
